text:
lia: Quick sync thread  we need to finalize the observability slices for the next release. Sales/customer asks: compact per-route cost, error analytics with trace links, and a low-cost tracing option. Keep it M1/M2.

omar: Proposed split:
M1: compact "cost by route" widget (7d/30d), error buckets (drop/retry/timeout), trace-id links to sampled traces, trace-index (metadata only).
M2: sampling slider, per-route overrides, optional full-span ingestion + retention tiers.

dina: Customer signal (CarinaHealth + VaultPay): per-route cost is the gating feature. They accept trace-id links and sample-based traces for now. Prioritize cost attribution.

kai: Engineering tradeoff: full-span ingestion = large storage/egress. Alternative: trace-index (store id, status, top spans, costs) and a fetch-on-demand path for full spans. This keeps steady telemetry costs. Also recommend default sample=0.1.

lia: Draft acceptance checklist (please react):
```
- Cost widget: per-route token_count, embedding_count, estimated $ cost; windows: 7d, 30d; filter by model and route prefix.
- Error analytics: grouped by error class with top affected routes and trace-id links.
- Trace hook: annotated server spans for sampled requests; trace-id surfaced in error details and logs.
- Trace-index retention: 90d; full-span retention: 7d by default.
- Rollout gates: canary to 3 pilot orgs for 1 week; telemetry cost delta <25% vs baseline; rollback if error rate >1.5x.
- Tests: synthetic prompt replay + cost smoke test + UI drilldown acceptance flows.
```

omar: Add infra req: cheap aggregated cost path (metrics rollup) + trace-index S3 path. I'll file INF-9001 and PIPE-9002.

kai: I'll own runtime annotated spans change (RUNTIME-9005). Estimate: 2w runtime + 1.5w infra in parallel. If we do on-demand full-span fetch, add ~3d.

dina: UX: widget stays compact on dashboards; "expand" shows top 5 traces and CTA "request full span". I'll drop mocks in Figma: https://redwood.internal/figma/compact-cost

ops-bot: Note: create alert to auto-disable full-span per org if telemetry delta > 30% vs baseline.

lia: Good point. We should surface an ops control in Console: telemetry guard with threshold and auto-toggle.

omar: Decision proposal: ship M1 = cost widget + trace-index + error buckets + trace-id links. Defer sampling UI and full-span to M2. Anyone object?

kai: +1. Recommend we document pricing assumptions (token costs, embeddings) in the one-pager.

dina: I'll author the one-pager and the drilldown copy.

omar: I'll post the infra/runtime tickets and PR-level estimates by EOD tomorrow.

lia: Owners: omar -> backend cost API + trace-index, kai -> runtime spans + alerting, dina -> UX + docs. If no objections by EOD, I'll mark as roadmap commit. :rocket:

kai: :thumbsup:

omar: :thumbsup:

dina: :thumbsup:

lia: Thanks team  I'll update the roadmap doc and add the rollout playbook link.
